title: Top Gear’s Richard Hammond fined for speeding in Bentley and Porsche - The Guardian
summary_full: Top Gear’s Richard Hammond fined for speeding in Bentley and Porsche  The GuardianFormer Top Gear host Richard Hammond was fined £999 for speeding twice in three weeks.  Sky NewsPolice struggled to find Richard Hammond after he was caught breaking the law  The Hereford TimesPictured: Richard Hammond caught speeding in luxury cars as he gets court fine  London Evening StandardRichard Hammond convicted of two speeding offences and fined £999 by court  Craven Herald
